record.question: What should be the procedure in making an arrest by Excise & Narcotics officers on Excise & Narcotics offences if such person forcibly resists the endeavour to arrest him, or attempts to evade arrest?
options: Pray to court for warrant of the arrest
Request the person until he/she agreed for the arrest
Use all means necessary to effect the arrest
Report to the officer-in-charge for necessary action
